summary: B42 (Customer Support Intelligence) and B43 (Property Data Import & Evidence Reconciliation) fully verified end-to-end. 22/22 backend pytest cases passed against https://step-by-step-diy.preview.emergentagent.com/api including assist classification (forgot-password -> account_access/high with 'Reset your password' article; 'hacked' -> critical), ticket priority escalation ('charged twice' -> critical), cross-user ticket isolation (404), admin desk (dashboard, priority-sorted list, priority change, reply -> waiting_user, resolve -> resolved, KB draft->publish), import job creation returning ready_for_review with new_information issues, accept -> hi_property_facts user_confirmed, and the critical re-import conflict test where a user-confirmed fact is protected=true and never auto-overwritten (keep leaves fact intact). Frontend Playwright flows pass on mobile viewport: Profile > Support Center opens /help; category chip -> message -> Get quick help shows assist answer + articles + 'That solved it'/'I still need help'; ticket form submits and appears under My tickets; ticket detail exposes td-reply/td-send. /home-intel/import loads config, field chips + value input + Review changes surface reconciliation issue cards whose Accept action resolves and disappears. Admin sidebar renders admin-nav-supportops (Support Desk, dashboard KPIs + Queue/KB tabs) and admin-nav-importops (Property Import, Jobs/Issues KPIs + issues-by-type + data sources); design, searchops, and communityhub still render — no key collisions. No red-screen errors, no route collisions with legacy /api/hi/support.
critical_code_review_comments: support_engine.py module docstring still references /api/hi/support/* (legacy) even though build_router now uses /api/hi/help. Consider updating the docstring for future maintainers.
import_engine.py POST /sources/connect uses reliability_level 'external_provider' but does not validate against RELIABILITY dict; safe today but worth an enum check.
admin update_source uses ?status=paused query param rather than a request body — acceptable but slightly inconsistent with other admin PUTs.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ticket + 1 TEST_ui_ticket via demo user, 1 TEST_KB_iter78 published article, several TEST_ import jobs & one TEST_source_* via admin. All prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: B42 user routes live at /api/hi/help/* (legacy /api/hi/support/* engine untouched). B43 user routes at /api/hi/import/*. Admin equivalents under /api/hi/admin/help and /api/hi/admin/import. Frontend testIDs: help-cat-<key>, help-message, help-ask, help-solved, help-still, help-subject, help-submit-ticket, help-ticket-<id>, td-reply, td-send, td-reopen, td-star-<n>; imp-field-0-<key>, imp-value-0, imp-submit, imp-accept-<id>, imp-keep-<id>; admin-nav-supportops, admin-nav-importops. Use UI login (auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button) — AsyncStorage backing is IndexedDB on web, so localStorage token injection does NOT authenticate the app.
